NEWSLETTER WELCOME EMAIL TEMPLATE
=================================

Copy this file and replace every [bracketed] part. Send immediately after
someone confirms their subscription (double opt-in). Keep the tone warm
and plain — like a friend would.

Subject: Welcome + [free gift, if you have one]

Hi [First name],

Thanks for signing up. I'm [Author name], author of [Book title].

Here is what to expect: [frequency] emails about [topics]. You can
unsubscribe at any time — the link is at the bottom of every email, and
I will never sell or share your address.

[If you have a free gift:] As promised, here is [gift link].

[If you have a book out:] You can find [Book title] at [retailer links].

Questions? Just reply to this email. I read every reply.

Best,
[Author name]
[Website]

SETUP NOTES
-----------
- Use your author email address, not your personal one.
- Turn on double opt-in so subscribers confirm their email.
- Every email must include a working unsubscribe link.
- No home address or personal phone in the footer unless the law requires
  one (use a PO box or business address instead).
